opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Motion for leave to file copies of petitioner's Appendix in the Court of Appeals granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice White and Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and petition.
